finalists.label: Malignant Peripheral Nerve Sheath Tumor (MPNST)
finalists.why: It has diffuse, strong positivity for S100 protein and SOX10, and HMB45 and Melan A were negative, which are specific findings for this tumor type.

finalists.label: Carcinoid tumor
finalists.why: It has focal segment of small-bowel wall thickening and transmural, infiltrative proliferation of uniform epithelioid and spindle cells, but the diffuse, strong positivity for S100 protein and SOX10 is not typical for this tumor type.

finalists.label: Neuroendocrine Tumor
finalists.why: It has transmural, infiltrative proliferation of uniform epithelioid and spindle cells and diffuse, strong positivity for S100 protein and SOX10, but the lack of specific neuroendocrine markers is a concern.

frontier_selector.why: The champion is chosen because it has the most specific findings, including diffuse, strong positivity for S100 protein and SOX10, and HMB45 and Melan A were negative, which are characteristic of MPNST.
